title: 3.0.0.1-dev-d crash
symptom: The app keeps crashing when the TBR could not be set. The crash log shows a fatal exception: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Received message while trying to send.
cause: The crash is caused by an IllegalStateException in the Omnipod Dash communication layer, specifically in MessageIO.sendMessage during session key negotiation.
fix: The crash was reported to be solved by PR #1403.
